<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex15012024-11-08-11-293" status="finalized">dang po ni 
            <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3807">'bre chen
            <lb n="88b3"/> po</rs>'i zhal nas mdo dang bstan bcos nas laM shes nyid bshad pa yin pas 'dir yang nyan thos kyi laM dang | tshul ji ltar shes par byed pa 2 kyis shes par bya'o || 
            dang po bden pa 4 la rnaM pa mi rtag laswo <abbr>bcu drug</abbr> gang zag gi bdag med par mthong pa dang de goms par byed pa'i laM 2 yin la | de 'dra ba rang rgyal ba dang byang chub <abbr>sems dpa'i</abbr> rgyud la skyes kyang nyan thos kyi laM du <abbr>bzhag go</abbr> ||
            <lb n="88b4"/> 2 pa ni sbyor ba'i dus su byang chub mchog tu <abbr>sems can</abbr> bskyed pa dang | dngos gzhi mi rtag pa 'swo pa bden par mi dmigs pa dang | rjes dge ba'i rtsa ba zla na med pa'i byang chub du bsngo ba'i seMs kyis zin pa'o zhes 'dod do || 
            de ni ma yin te |</seg></TEI>
source: 1_015_01_ 'Od zer mgon po _ mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan gyi rnam par 'byed pa'i 'grel ba.xml
